method: Unchanged EntityBoat (xi) as the ridden client copy on a remote world stand-in (as the b56 ride records), with other entities in the world list: a second boat (xi), a minecart (xm), a second player stand-in, an item (xk), moved by scripted per-tick offsets before the copy updates. World.getCollidingBoundingBoxes is the MinecartProbe stand-in of ahb.a(sa, azt) (other.getBoundingBox, then mover.getCollisionBox(other); bytecode-read equal). The rider is the real EntityLivingBase.fall (sv.b) on a stand-in with EntityPlayerSP.playSound (World.playSound, logged as played) and EntityClientPlayerMP.attackEntityFrom (return false, counted). Worlds by label: open = water x -4..24, z -8..8, y -1..0; pool = water -4..4 square; empty; floor12 / floor20 = sand / glass at y -1 over -3..4. No patched game classes.
